cohort: This study included 3331 singleton pregnancies at or beyond 34 weeks gestation delivered by vacuum extraction.
finding: Risk factors for adverse outcomes related to vacuum extraction include nulliparity, epidural anesthesia, use of a Ventouse-Mityvac cup, prolonged second stage of labor, cup detachment, longer procedure duration, and increasing neonatal birth weight, while occiput anterior fetal position was protective.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was measured and higher birth weight was a risk factor for adverse outcomes.
